title: Missing tx_queue_destroy implementation
description:
tx_queue_destroy is declared in tx_queue.h (line 231) but not defined in tx_queue.c. It is called by production code in lora_l2.c and tests in main.c. This will cause a linker error: undefined reference to tx_queue_destroy. The function should call pthread_mutex_destroy on POSIX and be a no-op on Zephyr.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 448
close_reason: Added missing tx_queue_destroy implementation: pthread_mutex_destroy on POSIX, no-op on Zephyr. Build succeeds, all 19 tx_queue tests pass.
